domestic_evidence: No public domestic-supply record found. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report splits could not be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com and volza.com returned HTTP 403; eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403; DuckDuckGo HTML endpoint returned HTTP 403; Bing returned only generic unrelated "glass" results; the web_search tool failed with a connection error ("searx: Connection refused"). No GSTIN, turnover figure or domestic contract is asserted here — all such fields are null because they are not public in the sources reachable.
note: Export activity is factually confirmed, not merely declared: five dated customs/B-L records between 2026-02-20 and 2026-02-28 with named foreign buyers (Espoir Flower Boutique Ltd/UAE, Roset S.A.S./France, Gervasoni SpA/Italy, Boconcept A/S/Denmark, Cecile Boyds/South Africa), HS codes 70200090 and 70139900, and B-L numbers 1129203, 1079158, 9992803, 9891468, 9846907. Declared HS 702000 (other articles of glass) is consistent with the observed 70200090 export lines; one line is 70139900 (other glassware), so the declared 6-digit code is broadly correct and no HS correction is needed. Role: the shipment records show the company as the Indian shipper/supplier side, i.e. manufacturer_trader or manufacturer — the records alone do not distinguish own production from trading, so role is not asserted. Caveat on identity: the ImportKey page carries no CIN/PAN/GSTIN, and the claimed legal name "RAJENDRA GUPTA" is not corroborated by any source reached; the address fragment "AGRA ROAD" (Firozabad/Agra glass-artware cluster) is the only locational anchor. A separate slug variant "glass-creations-pvt-ltd" returned an empty record set ("Loading..." / no rows), so the confirmed data belongs to the un-suffixed entity only. Domestic supply: no traces of domestic deliveries found in reachable public sources — status left as unknown rather than none_found, because the registries that would settle it (GST/GeM/CPPP) were blocked by 403/connection errors, not because they were checked and came back empty. Revenue and export volume: null — ImportKey shows record counts, not values, and no rupee or USD figure is public.
